summary.note: Test run covering the 11 research-priority names only. No Strict Tier 1 BUYs. Technicals (RSI/MACD/ATR) were not pulled in this run.

names.reason: Q3 revenue +41%, operating margin ~29.5%, cheap on forward earnings. Single-franchise (Ingrezza) risk and the post-earnings pop thin the margin of safety.
names.entry: Wait for a pullback toward $150-160 (the Nov 5-6 gap area).
names.upgrade: A pullback that gives 20%+ discount to fair value, or evidence the VYKAT XR launch is durable.

names.reason: Forward P/E ~10.8x (non-GAAP), $870M cash plus $230M securities, 52% below its high. Growth is slowing to ~14% in Q4 and Q3 FCF margin was only ~4%.
names.entry: About 36% above its 52-week low after a ~7% post-earnings drop; no technicals pulled.
names.upgrade: FCF margin recovery and signs growth is stabilizing near 15-20%.

names.reason: Operating ROE ~19% at ~1.5x book ex-AOCI and ~9.5x forward earnings. Organic growth is below the 15% hurdle, Q3 EPS had an investment windfall, and the stock is at its 52-week high.
names.entry: Extended after a breakout; prefer a pullback toward $255-265.
names.upgrade: A pullback to the $255-265 area, or evidence earnings quality holds without one-time items.

names.reason: Q3 revenue +25%, $229M cash and no debt. Q4 guide implies only ~12% growth with thinner margins. Forward P/E rescaled to today's price is a rough ~13-14x.
names.entry: Up sharply from the pre-earnings $22.74; no technicals pulled.
names.upgrade: Verified FCF yield and ROIC, and evidence Q4/Q1 growth stays above 15%.

names.reason: Backlog $2.4B (+69%), no debt, strong cash conversion. But Q3 revenue growth was only ~9%, forward P/E ~22x and P/S ~4.4x. Oil and gas is ~34% of revenue.
names.entry: Do not act before fiscal Q4 results on Mon Nov 16 after the close.
names.upgrade: A strong Nov 16 print and a lower entry price (forward P/E near 20x or below).

names.reason: Q3 distributable earnings per share $0.73 (+16%), ~15x P/DE, buybacks. GAAP metrics are not meaningful and the discount to fair value is thin. Nov 13 close not verified.
names.entry: Support near $36; add on dips toward the high $30s.
names.upgrade: A deeper discount to fair value (25%+) or evidence of faster DE growth.

names.reason: Q3 sales +16%, ~$4.5B data-center backlog, FCF improving. Estimated P/S of ~2.5x probably fails the valuation requirement.
names.entry: 35% above its 52-week low; residential demand is cyclical and storm-driven.
names.upgrade: A lower price (P/S near 2x) with the data-center backlog converting to sales.

names.reason: Q3 growth of 14% is below the 15% hurdle, FCF margin ~1%, SBC ~7% of revenue and gross margin is pressured by memory costs.
names.upgrade: Growth back above 15% and FCF conversion improving.

names.reason: Negative free cash flow, thin margins, trailing loss, two-customer concentration and high cyclicality. Forward growth is strong but fundamentals do not clear Tier 1.
names.entry: Extremely volatile; revisit only after FCF turns positive.
names.upgrade: Positive free cash flow and margin expansion.

names.reason: Revenue +21% but GAAP operating margin -31%, ROIC negative, FCF yield under 1% and forward P/S ~6x. Nov 13 close not verified.
names.entry: Q3 earnings Dec 3; wait for that or a pullback toward $17-18.
names.upgrade: GAAP profitability and a much lower valuation.

names.reason: Growth is acquisition-driven with heavy dilution, falling gross margin, large operating losses, negative FCF and very high short interest.
names.upgrade: Organic growth proof, positive adjusted EBITDA and lower dilution.
